apply.title: CU Boulder — First-Year Apply (deadlines, checklist, fee)

faq.title: CU Boulder — International Applicant FAQs (scholarships, financial aid)

test_policy.notes: ACT and SAT scores are not required for first-year students; self-reported scores may be provided and are considered if submitted.

requirements.notes: Fee is $70 for international applicants ($65 domestic); fee waiver can be requested on the Common App. Needs the Common App personal essay plus one required 250-word short answer ('What do you hope to study, and why, at CU Boulder?') and ONE letter of recommendation (from a recommender of the student's choice; page does not say teacher vs counselor). Transcripts required.

deadlines.label: Fall early action
deadlines.notes: Fall and summer early action deadline (Nov. 15). Page states the 2027 application is open; the year is implied, not printed next to the date.

deadlines.label: Fall regular decision
deadlines.notes: Jan. 15. International applicants must have all required documents and English proficiency on file by Jan. 15 to be reviewed for automatic-consideration scholarships; scholarship awards are sent with the admission decision.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Proof can be submitted before or after admission review, but must be on file for scholarship consideration (by the RD deadline) and before confirming enrollment. Alternatives to a test: 2 years of full-time secondary study in a qualifying English-speaking country; 24 transferable credits at a university in a qualifying country; IB SL English A 6 / HL 5, AP English 4, SAT EBRW 580, ACT English 23, GCSE/GCE English B, WASSCE/WAEC B3. Results must be within two calendar years of the CU Boulder start date.

english.notes: Listed as 'TOEFL iBT26 (post January 2026)', minimum total 4.0.

aid.notes: Non-US citizens are not eligible for federal aid and CU Boulder offers no direct loans. All international first-year applications with complete documents by Jan. 15 (and English proficiency on file) are automatically reviewed for the Chancellor's Achievement Scholarship and the Presidential Scholarship; no SAT/ACT needed. Full scholarships are rare (athletics; College of Music offers tuition awards).

tier_notes.math_physics: Physics (JILA) is among the top US departments.
tier_notes.nursing: No nursing at Boulder (CU nursing is at Anschutz).
